Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

at

conjunction, first in its clause

but (sharply); but, you say; whereas, but on the other hand

In this lexicon

  • but

    also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 21: at memoria minuitur; Verg. G. 4.6: in tenuī labor; at tenuis nōn glōria

  • whereas

    also used · classical · Liv. 1.7.1: tempore illī praeceptō, at hī numerō avium rēgnum trahēbant; Gell. 13.24.2: vitiō vertunt, quia multa egeō; at ego illīs, quia nequeunt egēre

Examples

  • at memoria minuitur. crēdō, nisi eam exerceās

    but memory fades. — I dare say, if you don’t exercise itCic. Sen. 21

    In the entry for but

  • in tenuī labor; at tenuis nōn glōria

    the work is on a small thing, but the glory is not smallVerg. G. 4.6

    In the entry for but

  • tempore illī praeceptō, at hī numerō avium rēgnum trahēbant

    the one side claimed the kingdom by being first, whereas the other claimed it by the number of birdsLiv. 1.7.1

    In the entry for whereas

  • vitiō vertunt, quia multa egeō; at ego illīs, quia nequeunt egēre

    they find fault with me because I go without many things, whereas I find fault with them because they cannot go withoutGell. 13.24.2

    In the entry for whereas
